what: An 89%-wide video frame with its top covered by a background-color band widens one step at a time, at .3s ease, each time scrolling crosses the 10, 100 and 150px thresholds: width 93→97→100%, top band 308→200→100→0px, until it fills the screen (scrolling back narrows it at the same thresholds). Past 600px a dark veil (30%) lays over the video at 1s ease. A frame moved by threshold classes.

options.widths: Width (%) per threshold, with the first value prepended, so threshold count + 1 values. Default 89,93,97,100
options.bands: Top band height (px) at each threshold, same count. Default 308,200,100,0
options.shade: Scroll distance (px) over which the dark veil falls, default 600 — 0 means no veil
options.--fx-shade: Curtain color, default 30% of the stage color opposite the background
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Video or photo inside the frame (if present, it spreads to full screen width, wider than the frame, so the center looks cropped)

from.where: index.js .hb-mvframe — original setting.js: scrollTop > At 10·100·150·600, .mv-video.scale01·02·03·05, CSS width 89→93→97→100% · ::before 308→200→100→0px transition all .3s ease · ::after rgba(0,0,0,.3) 1s ease
